install:
export PATH="$HOME/miniconda3/bin:$PATH"
if [ ! -x "$HOME/miniconda3/bin/conda" ]; then curl -fsSL https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh -o /tmp/miniconda.sh; bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p "$HOME/miniconda3"; fi
source "$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda env list | grep -q '^env_GenNet ' || conda create -n env_GenNet python=3.10.12 -y
if [ -f requirements_GenNet.txt ]; then REQ=requirements_GenNet.txt; elif [ -f /home/roshchupkin/GenNet/requirements_GenNet.txt ]; then REQ=/home/roshchupkin/GenNet/requirements_GenNet.txt; else git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ComPopBio/GenNet.git /tmp/GenNet; REQ=/tmp/GenNet/requirements_GenNet.txt; fi
conda run -n env_GenNet python -m pip install --upgrade pip
conda run -n env_GenNet python -m pip install -r "$REQ"
